office: Speaker pro tempore, New Hampshire House of Representatives
label: Written by AI from public sources — may contain errors.

items.t: Pledged to oppose and vote against any and all efforts to increase taxes.
items.q: On the Granite State Taxpayers Survey, Jim Kofalt pledged, "I will oppose and vote against any and all efforts to increase taxes.

items.t: Voted against HB 106, which would have established a commission on the financial cost of climate damage to New Hampshire, in 2025.
items.q: In 2025 Rep. Kofalt voted against HB 106, which would have established a commission to determine the financial cost of climate damage to New Hampshire and methods of recouping such costs.

items.t: Voted against establishing a climate and health protection program (SB 496) in 2024.
items.q: In 2024 Rep. Kofalt voted against establishing a climate and health protection program (SB 496).

items.t: Voted against increasing base per-pupil state school funding (HB 651 and HB 1826) in 2025 and 2026.
items.q: In 2025 and 2026 Rep. Kofalt voted against increasing base per-pupil state school funding (HB 651 and HB 1826).

items.t: Voted to keep the Education Freedom Account program (HB 1683) in 2022.
items.q: In 2022, Kofalt voted to keep the Education Freedom Account program (HB 1683).

items.t: Voted for HB 1419, a bill to ban various sex-related content in K-12 schools, and HB 1312, a parental notification bill on certain curriculum.
items.q: Rep. Kofalt voted for HB 1419, a bill to ban various sex-related content in K-12 schools.

items.t: Said HB 148 protects vulnerable populations, including women in prisons, shelters, and detention centers.
items.q: “HB 148 protects vulnerable populations, ensuring that women in prisons, shelters, and detention centers aren’t forced to share intimate spaces with biological men.”

items.t: Voted for HB 1291 and HB 1399 and voted against HB 1400 in 2024.
items.q: In 2024 Rep. Kofalt voted for HB 1291 (which would increase rights of property owners to build accessory dwelling units) and HB 1399

items.t: Voted to limit parking requirements in zoning laws (SB 284) and to prohibit planning boards from differentiating based on number of bedrooms (SB 174) in 2025.
items.q: In 2025 Rep. Kofalt voted to limit parking requirements in zoning laws (SB 284) and voted to prohibit planning boards from differentiating based on the number of bedrooms in a residential development (SB 174).

items.t: Voted to repeal the Housing Champion designation and grant program (HB 1196) in 2026.
items.q: In 2026 Rep. Kofalt voted to repeal the Housing Champion designation and grant program (HB 1196).

record.t: Served as Deputy Majority Leader from 2023 to 2024.
record.q: I've previously served as Advisor to the Speaker (2025) and Deputy Majority Leader (2023-2024).

record.t: Served on the Health, Human Services and Elderly Affairs and House Rules committees.
record.q: I also serve on the Health & Human Services and Elderly Affairs and House Rules committees.

record.t: Served as Speaker Pro Tempore of the NH House after being first elected to the House in 2020.
record.q: First elected to the NH House in 2020, representing Wilton, Temple and New Ipswich, I am currently in my third term, now serving as the Speaker Pro Tempore.

record.t: Cosponsored legislation that he called a critical step toward safeguarding women's rights.
record.q: Republican Speaker Pro Tempore Jim Kofalt, a cosponsor of the legislation, said the bill is a “critical step” to safeguarding women’s rights.
